plant: SeQUeNCe discrete-event simulator through the author's qnet_network.env.sequence_runner (run_sequence_episode), configured by routing_loop.make_config(variant)
requests: routing_loop.make_request(default_rng(seed), variant); SeQUeNCe nodes seeded with the same seed
policy_generator: numpy.random.default_rng(0), one stream over the episodes in order (export convention)

author_sequence.weights: runs/agent/policy.npz and runs/agent/temperature.json of the author's repository archive (external/VENDORED.json source_sha256)

primary: agent vs greedy fidelity, success rate, per variant, in SeQUeNCe (two-sided)
secondary: each policy in SeQUeNCe vs the same policy in the analytic twin, success rate, same requests
test: exact paired sign-flip test over 20 block means of 50 episodes
multiplicity: Holm over the 2 primary tests; Holm over the 8 secondary tests
interpretation: SeQUeNCe with the author's hardware parameters; a simulator, not a deployed network or permission to act
